tools.name: check_exclusions
tools.description: Check 1 to 20 identities against a dated active SAM snapshot. Pass identities as an array of objects, not a record ID or page URL. Each identity needs a name, UEI, CAGE, or NPI. Exact identifier matches and name-only possible matches remain distinct. Read coverage.freshness; stale or unknown-source

tools.name: create_saved_search
tools.description: Create one private saved opportunity search with the supplied name and criteria. Requires authenticated workspace access and explicit user intent. Creates an account workspace if needed and adds a search without replacing existing searches. Returns a private feed link. The first successful check est

tools.name: delete_saved_search
tools.description: Permanently delete one saved search owned by the authenticated private workspace, including its baseline, retained change events and feed link. Requires explicit user intent; does not delete other searches or public records.

tools.name: delete_saved_search_workspace
tools.description: Permanently delete the authenticated private saved-search workspace and all its searches, baselines, change events and feed links. Requires explicit user intent to delete the entire workspace. Does not delete the GovGazette login account, public records or another workspace.

tools.name: detail
tools.description: Retrieve a known public identifier. Supply generation from search for a consistent result.

tools.name: document
tools.description: Read bounded official record text by known identifier. Does not fetch arbitrary URLs or paths.

tools.name: exclusion_changes
tools.description: Compare two retained snapshots. No longer observed does not mean reinstated; enrichment-only changes are excluded.

tools.name: exclusion_context
tools.description: Retrieve an exclusion with agency explanation, named restriction references, source evidence, explicit source-age warnings and supported business links.

tools.name: explain_match
tools.description: Explain deterministic primary NAICS overlap between a registered vendor and opportunity. Not an eligibility determination.

tools.name: freshness
tools.description: Report actual source dates, coverage, record counts and SHA256 provenance.

tools.name: get_saved_search_events
tools.description: Read the latest 100 retained change observations for one saved search owned by the authenticated private workspace. Does not change the search. Retention and missing intermediate observations are explicit; observations are not proof of delivered notifications.

tools.name: list_saved_searches
tools.description: List the saved opportunity searches in the authenticated private workspace, including criteria, status and change counts. Does not change searches. Requires workspace Authorization headers on /mcp or account OAuth on /account/mcp; never accept keys in tool arguments.

tools.name: research_opportunity
tools.description: Build a cited research brief with retained notice requirements, exact award-number candidates and same-industry comparisons. Does not infer an incumbent or eligibility.

tools.name: rotate_saved_search_feed
tools.description: Replace the private feed link for one saved search owned by the authenticated workspace, immediately revoking its previous link. Requires explicit user intent. Does not delete the search or its events. Keep the replacement link private; a lost response may mean the link changed and cannot be recover

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search public opportunities, vendors, awards, exclusions, or reference collections. Results include provenance and a generation-pinned cursor.

tools.name: search_exclusions
tools.description: Filter active exclusion records by agency, program, classification, geography and dates. Preserve the returned cursor and generation. Read coverage.freshness for source age and warnings; results are dated evidence, not clearance.

tools.name: search_opportunities
tools.description: Find official opportunity records by keywords, industry, set-aside, state, agency and source status. Active does not imply the deadline is open.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_saved_searches" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_exclusions, create_saved_search, delete_saved_search, delete_saved_search_workspace, document, get_saved_search_events, rotate_saved_search_feed · Private data: check_exclusions, create_saved_search, delete_saved_search, delete_saved_search_workspace, document, freshness, get_saved_search_events, list_saved_searches, rotate_saved_search_feed, search_exclusions, search_opportunities · Public sink: create_saved_search · Destructive: delete_saved_search, delete_saved_search_workspace, rotate_saved_search_feed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_exclusions, create_saved_search, delete_saved_search, delete_saved_search_workspace, document, get_saved_search_events, rotate_saved_search_feed · Private data: check_exclusions, create_saved_search, delete_saved_search, delete_saved_search_workspace, document, freshness, get_saved_search_events, list_saved_searches, rotate_saved_search_feed, search_exclusions, search_opportunities · Public sink: create_saved_search · Destructive: delete_saved_search, delete_saved_search_workspace, rotate_saved_search_feed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
